Annotators compare two model variants and judge which is better or tied on consistency, proactivity, coherence, and target success rate.

Given a pair of dialogues produced by two variants of tuning for the same backbone model, we recruited three well-educated graduate students as the annotators to evaluate which one is better (or tied) from the dimensions of consistency (Consist.), proactivity (Proact.), coherence (Coh.), and target success rate (Succ.).
